s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic gastrointestinal bleeding in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: Multiple semisessile polyps in the rectum and sigmoid colon
Mixed inflammatory infiltrate with pale histiocytes and basophilic inclusions
key_facts: 13-year-old boy with T-cell lymphoblastic leukemia
Receiving maintenance therapy with 6-mercaptopurine, methotrexate, vincristine, and dexamethasone
Intermittent neutropenia and consistent lymphopenia
Two to three loose bowel movements per day with mixed blood
No abdominal pain, weight loss, rashes, arthritis, or oral or perianal lesions
Stool studies negative for Clostridioides difficile, cytomegalovirus, and adenovirus
Colonoscopy showed multiple polyps in the rectum and sigmoid colon
Histologic examination revealed eroded surface mucosa and dense mixed inflammatory infiltrate
Histiocytes contained numerous basophilic spherical and targetoid inclusions
Inclusions were positive on von Kossa and periodic acid-Schiff stains

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic gastrointestinal bleeding in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: Multiple semisessile polyps in the rectum and sigmoid colon
Mixed inflammatory infiltrate with pale histiocytes and basophilic inclusions
key_facts: 13-year-old boy with T-cell lymphoblastic leukemia
Receiving maintenance therapy with 6-mercaptopurine, methotrexate, vincristine, and dexamethasone
Intermittent neutropenia and consistent lymphopenia
Two to three loose bowel movements per day with mixed blood
No abdominal pain, weight loss, rashes, arthritis, or oral or perianal lesions
Stool studies negative for Clostridioides difficile, cytomegalovirus, and adenovirus

differentials: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia with gastrointestinal involvement
per_call: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia with gastrointestinal involvement

shortlist.label: Malakoplakia
shortlist.why_kept: Histologic examination revealed eroded surface mucosa and dense mixed inflammatory infiltrate with basophilic spherical and targetoid inclusions positive on von Kossa and periodic acid-Schiff stains

shortlist.label: Erdheim-Chester disease
shortlist.why_kept: Histiocytes contained numerous basophilic spherical and targetoid inclusions, consistent with Erdheim-Chester disease

shortlist.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Dense mixed inflammatory infiltrate with histiocytes and eosinophils, neutrophils, and lymphocytes, consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis

shortlist.label: Neutropenic colitis
shortlist.why_kept: Intermittent neutropenia and consistent lymphopenia, with symptoms of chronic gastrointestinal bleeding

shortlist.label: Cytomegalovirus colitis
shortlist.why_kept: Immunocompromised patient with chronic gastrointestinal bleeding, although stool studies were negative for Cytomegalovirus

raw.rationale: The presence of basophilic spherical and targetoid inclusions in histiocytes that are positive on von Kossa and periodic acid-Schiff stains is characteristic of Malakoplakia, a rare inflammatory condition often associated with immunocompromised states.

rejected.label: Erdheim-Chester disease
rejected.why: It is a systemic histiocytic disorder that typically presents with bone pain, exophthalmos, and skin lesions, which are not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
rejected.why: It is characterized by the proliferation of Langerhans cells, which is not indicated by the histologic findings in this case.

rejected.label: Neutropenic colitis
rejected.why: While the patient is intermittently neutropenic, the colonoscopy and histologic findings do not support a diagnosis of neutropenic colitis, which typically presents with more severe inflammation and ulceration.

rejected.label: Cytomegalovirus colitis
rejected.why: Stool studies and histologic examination did not reveal evidence of cytomegalovirus infection, making this diagnosis unlikely.
